content.value_statement: Full-stack feature delivery is hard to coordinate across data, API, UI, testing, deployment, and operations. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through phased agent tasks with clear outputs and validation.
actual_capabilities: Defines a phased workflow from database architecture through production operations.
Provides prompts for database, backend, frontend, testing, security, deployment, and performance agents.
Guides API-first planning with OpenAPI or GraphQL contracts before implementation.
Includes testing coverage for contracts, integration flows, end-to-end journeys, and performance.
Covers deployment, feature flags, observability, monitoring, and rollout readiness.
limitations: It provides orchestration guidance, not a complete implementation by itself.
It assumes the referenced subagents or equivalent specialists are available.
It requires clear product requirements, stack choices, and deployment targets.
It does not replace environment-specific security, compliance, or operations review.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Turn an unclear feature request into architecture, implementation, testing, and rollout tasks.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Specialist Agents
use_cases.description: Assign database, backend, frontend, test, security, and deployment work in a logical sequence.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Rollout
use_cases.description: Build a release plan that includes feature flags, observability, performance checks, and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Feature Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a single full-stack feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a full-stack feature for: [feature]. My stack is [stack], and my main success criteria are [criteria].

prompt_templates.title: Create API-First Tasks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow design for backend and frontend teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to break [feature] into database, API contract, backend, frontend, and integration tasks. Include expected outputs for each phase.

prompt_templates.title: Add Testing and Security Gates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced readiness review before implementation starts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define contract tests, end-to-end tests, security checks, and acceptance criteria for [feature] on [stack].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release orchestration for a production environment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a deployment, observability, feature flag, performance, and rollback plan for [feature] targeting [deployment target].

output_examples.input: Plan a customer billing dashboard with React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
output: Database work covers accounts, invoices, payments, access rules, indexes, and migrations.
Backend work defines API contracts, authorization, validation, logging, and integration tests.
Frontend work covers dashboard components, data fetching, forms, accessibility, and responsive views.
Release work includes contract tests, end-to-end tests, monitoring, feature flags, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare a production rollout for a GraphQL inventory feature on AWS.
output: The plan identifies service boundaries, schema ownership, integration risks, and deployment dependencies.
Testing includes GraphQL contract checks, critical user journeys, load tests, and security review.
Operations work covers dashboards, alerts, tracing, rollout stages, and rollback criteria.

best_practices: Define API contracts before backend and frontend implementation begins.
Keep each phase tied to explicit inputs, outputs, and success criteria.
Validate production readiness with tests, security review, monitoring, and rollback planning.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before requirements, contracts, and data models are clear.
Skipping integration, security, or end-to-end validation for user-facing features.
Treating generated plans as production-ready without environment-specific review.

faq.question: What does this skill help coordinate?
faq.answer: It coordinates database, backend, frontend, testing, security, deployment, observability, and performance work for full-stack features.

faq.question: Does it generate application code directly?
faq.answer: It primarily provides orchestration prompts and expected outputs. Implementation depends on the connected agents and project context.

faq.question: Which stacks does it support?
faq.answer: It is stack-neutral and includes examples for React, Next.js, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, REST, and GraphQL.

faq.question: Can it support production releases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes deployment, CI/CD, feature flags, observability, performance checks, and rollback planning.

faq.question: Does it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It includes security audit prompts, but teams still need project-specific validation and expert review.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the feature goal, preferred stack, deployment target, API style, testing depth, compliance needs, and success criteria.
